# Quick tutorial on loading the EHE/ECE [GridEX](intro_gridex.html) data

::: {.callout-note}
This tutorial loads the state-level event summary from the January 2024 GridEX release, pinned to a fixed commit of the [GridEX repository](https://github.com/epedram/us_ehe_ece). That summary file was later retired upstream; see the repository for the current data files.
:::

## Loading the base spatial data set including Counties and States boundaries


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
states_file_path <- url('https://github.com/epedram/us_ehe_ece/raw/bbfef02e3c958b74b61cc60333f7a5d794da3c56/iv_ehe_ece_data_integration/data/us49_states_geo_tigris.rds')

states_geo <- readRDS(states_file_path)[[1]]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
Warning in readRDS(states_file_path): strings not representable in native
encoding will be translated to UTF-8
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
counties_file_path <- url('https://github.com/epedram/us_ehe_ece/raw/bbfef02e3c958b74b61cc60333f7a5d794da3c56/iv_ehe_ece_data_integration/data/us49_counties_geo_tigris.rds')

counties_geo <- readRDS(counties_file_path)[[1]]
```

```

encoding will be translated to UTF-8
```

## Loading the aggregate extreme events data set


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
events_catalog_file_path <- url('https://github.com/epedram/us_ehe_ece/raw/bbfef02e3c958b74b61cc60333f7a5d794da3c56/iv_ehe_ece_data_integration/data/States_events_by_type_sf_2008_2022.rds')

events_catalog_sf <- readRDS(events_catalog_file_path)[[1]] %>% 
  dplyr::filter(event_type == "Extreme Heat Event")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```

native encoding will be translated to UTF-8
```


:::


## Example of merging States boundaries with summarized EHE data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
state_boundaris_ehe_catalog <- merge(states_geo,
          events_catalog_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
          by.x="GEOID",
          by.y="GEOID",
          all.x = TRUE,
          all.y = TRUE,
          suffix = c("","_sp")) %>% st_as_sf() 

glimpse(state_boundaris_ehe_catalog)
```

## Mapping the summarized EHE data merged with the States boundaries


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
total_ehe_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = state_boundaris_ehe_catalog,
            aes(fill = total_event_days),
            lwd = .1) + 
    scale_fill_viridis(option="inferno", 
                       direction = -1,
                       na.value = NA) +

    labs(fill = "Total Number of EHE Days (2008-2022)") +

    theme_void() + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

#ggsave("./data/Total_Number_of_EHE_Days_2008_2022.jpg",
#         plot = total_ehe_plot, dpi = 300,
#         width = 22, height = 18, units = "cm")

total_ehe_plot
```
